description: Required disclosures for insurance broker communications (per PEAK6 spec requirements)
general: This is not a binding quote. Final rates subject to underwriting approval.
All information provided is for informational purposes only and does not constitute an offer of insurance.
Licensed insurance agent consultation required before policy issuance.
Actual savings and eligibility may vary based on underwriting review.
Quotes and savings estimates based on publicly available information and may not reflect current rates.

CA: California residents: This quote does not include earthquake coverage. Earthquake insurance available separately.
California Insurance Code requires disclosure of credit-based insurance score usage in underwriting.
TX: Texas residents: Rates shown are estimates. Final rates determined by Texas Department of Insurance approved filings.
Texas law prohibits discrimination based on credit score alone.
FL: Florida residents: Hurricane coverage may require separate policy or rider. Flood insurance available through NFIP.
Florida law requires disclosure of sinkhole coverage availability.
NY: New York residents: Rates subject to New York Department of Financial Services approval.
New York Insurance Law prohibits unfair discrimination in rates and underwriting.
IL: Illinois residents: Rates shown are estimates based on Illinois Department of Insurance approved filings.
Illinois law requires disclosure of factors used in rate determination.

auto: Auto insurance quotes require driver information, vehicle details, and coverage selections.
State minimum liability coverage requirements vary. Recommended coverage may exceed minimums.
Gap insurance and rental car coverage available as optional add-ons.
home: Home insurance quotes require property details, coverage amount, and deductible selection.
Flood and earthquake coverage typically require separate policies.
Actual replacement cost may differ from estimated dwelling coverage.
renters: Renters insurance covers personal property and liability. Landlord's policy covers building structure.
Replacement cost vs. actual cash value options available for personal property coverage.
umbrella: Umbrella policies typically require underlying auto and home liability coverage.
Coverage limits start at $1 million. Higher limits available based on underwriting.

handoff.message: To proceed with this quote, please contact a licensed insurance agent who can review your specific needs and provide a binding quote.
handoff.contactInfo: Agent contact information and license number must be provided before policy issuance.

dataUse: Information you provide will be used for quote generation and may be shared with insurance carriers for underwriting purposes.
Your privacy is important. See our privacy policy for details on data handling and storage.
